summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its second-quarter 2026 shareholders report and results. The filing reports routine quarterly financial results: underlying net income of $1,123 million, reported net income of $1,008 million, underlying EPS of $2.02, and an underlying ROE of 19.1%. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing appears to be a standard earnings release for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event.
